text:
APPROVE

`AppendStar` reproduces the original `*` handling exactly: `[^/]*` with no extra characters consumed, `(?:[^/]*/)*` consuming two more, and `.*` consuming one more. Returning the last index consumed and assigning it to `i` matches the old `i += 2` / `i++` behavior. Moving the nested branches out of `ToRegex` removes several nesting-weighted increments, which should bring it from 16 to well under 15. The new private static helper uses the same fully-qualified `StringBuilder` as the surrounding code and introduces nothing that would trigger a warning.

I judged this from the diff alone and did not build the project or run the complexity analyzer.
